defs.def: to receive and send on information, news, etc. to sb 转发（信息、消息等）

ex.s: The president is relaying his ambition to the audience.
ex.t: 总统正在向观众传达他的抱负。

ex.s: Today, I want to relay to you that I’m proud of the work my mother has done, and I am now supportive of it.
ex.t: 今天，我想转达给你们，我为我母亲所做的工作感到骄傲，现在我也支持它了。

defs.def: to broadcast television or radio signals 播放，转播（电视或广播讯号）
a race between teams in which each member of the team runs or swims one section of the race 接力赛

ex.s: Last Saturday, I went to the school playground to watch the final of the 4x100-metre relay at our annual sports tournament.
ex.t: 上周六，我去学校操场观看了我们年度体育锦标赛的4x100米接力决赛。

ex.s: The focus is on building bridges between different cultures, so there are competitions featuring mixed teams, such as mixed swimming relays.
ex.t: 重点是搭建不同文化之间的桥梁，所以有混合队伍参加的比赛，如混合游泳接力。

defs.def: a fresh set of people or animals that take the place of others that are tired or have finished a period of work 接班的人（或动物）；轮换者
an electronic device that receives radio or television signals and sends them on again with greater strength 中继设备

chunks.cn: 转发 在 我们的
